title: ExplodeOnDie
body:
This mod gives players an exploding animation on death.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52ed5925709792b84447554f94190f7acbc36cde.gif)

_The exploding animation is from ExplodeOnDie. The camera effects are from [Cinematic Respawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cinematic-respawn)._

Requires Fabric API when using Fabric or Quilt. 

This mod is all done on the client; this will work perfectly fine on servers like Hypixel. Additionally, no blocks will be destroyed, it is just an animation.

Also, armor is shown on the body parts that explode.

![Hypixel Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef69c3cdb0186113951635075271be9a9f276596.gif)

_A player explodes on Hypixel._
